chunks: And by his chain, he said, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
The one who intends that he be measured with the fullest measure (maximum reward),
so let him say whenever he intends to arise from his gathering,
Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honour, from what they are describing
And peace be on the Messengers
And the Praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds

key_terms.الْمِكْيَالِ الْأَوْفَى: The fullest measure (metaphor for maximum reward)

ai.seo_question: What should one recite when leaving a gathering to gain maximum reward?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) prescribes reciting the concluding verses of Surah As-Saff (37:180-182) when rising from a gathering to ensure the completeness of one's worship and reward. This practice, rooted in the Prophetic tradition of concluding gatherings with dhikr, serves as a spiritual safeguard against the distractions of the world and reinforces the believer's connection to the Divine before departing. It highlights the Shia emphasis on transforming mundane social interactions into acts of devotion through specific, prescribed remembrances.
